release_reason: Per-region release check on non-overlapping evaluation regions ['BGD', 'AUS-NSW', 'USA-CA'] (whole-country AUS / USA and the BGD divisions are reported separately, not gated); validated_calibration needs the selected model to beat B0_identity AND B0_month_ratio on test AOI-month MAE and 80% interval coverage within ±0.10 of 0.80 in EVERY region; the overall stage is the weakest region. Regions: BGD: validated_calibration (test AOI-month MAE selected=97.55 vs B0_identity=626.92 / B0_month_ratio=108.60; coverage 0.75 on n=24) | AUS-NSW: observed_comparison (test AOI-month MAE selected=374.96 vs B0_identity=4087.38 / B0_month_ratio=1640.44; coverage 1.00 on n=24; interval coverage outside 0.80±0.10) | USA-CA: validated_calibration (test AOI-month MAE selected=793.85 vs B0_identity=2218.62 / B0_month_ratio=909.37; coverage 0.83 on n=24). B2_xgb passed the gate (val AOI-month MAE 588.648 ≤ bar 872.495; lowest among 2 passing) | each region has at most 12 months × 2 test years = 24 AOI-months (n is given per region), so its interval coverage has a standard error of about 0.08: coarse evidence

gate.rule: candidate replaces baseline only if val AOI-month MAE ≤ (1−0.1)×baseline and active-subgroup (aqua_count>0) cell-month MAE ≤ (1+0.1)×baseline; among passing candidates the lowest val AOI-month MAE wins

Partial months (S-NPP from 2012-01-20, Aqua from 2002-07-03, last month of a current-year file, months with NRT rows) are extract_status=partial: observed counts shown but excluded from training, baselines and anomalies.
Years that Notebook A marked missing (e.g. FIRMS 2025 yearly country files: 404) stay on the calendar as unavailable (null, extract_status missing), never zero.

Release stage is decided per region on non-overlapping evaluation regions (see release); the all-AOI pooled AOI-month metric ('all') double-counts nested AOIs and is descriptive only; the gate uses the 'gate_units' subgroup.
Absolute local paths are replaced by placeholders (<input>, <work>, <run>, <home>, <local-path>, <kaggle-path>) in every exported file.
Anomaly flags: |z(log1p)|≥1 vs same calendar month in other years (2003+), retrospective.
